types.name: Author
types.description: A person who writes Books. `name` is full-text searchable; the write loop creates an Author, and the atomic-workflow loop creates an Author and its Books in one batch (intra-batch reference: the Book's `author` points at the not-yet-committed Author by its batch ref).

fields.name: booksCount
fields.description: Cardinality of `books` without resolving its member objects — a single indexed COUNT(*) over the relationship edges (issue #132).

fields.name: books
fields.description: Resolved Book for `books` (graph traversal; batched per request).

types.name: String
types.description: The `String` scalar type represents textual data, represented as UTF-8 character sequences. The String type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.

types.name: Int
types.description: The `Int` scalar type represents non-fractional signed whole numeric values. Int can represent values between -(2^31) and 2^31 - 1.

types.name: ID
types.description: The `ID` scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"4"`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.

types.name: Boolean
types.description: The `Boolean` scalar type represents `true` or `false`.

types.name: DateTime
types.description: ISO-8601 datetime string (UTC).

types.name: Book
types.description: A published work. `format` (enum) and `in_print` (boolean) drive facets; `author` is a typed reference used for cross-links and batch resolution.

fields.name: coAuthorsCount
fields.description: Cardinality of `co_authors` without resolving its member objects — a single indexed COUNT(*) over the relationship edges (issue #132).

fields.name: author
fields.description: Resolved Author for `author` (graph traversal; batched per request).

fields.name: coAuthors
fields.description: Resolved Author for `co_authors` (graph traversal; batched per request).

types.name: BookFormat
types.description: Physical/digital form of a Book — drives an enum facet in browse/filter.

types.name: AuthorPage
types.description: Offset-paginated Author result set (mirrors the SDK's PaginatedResult).

types.name: FilterInput
types.description: Field/value filter (SDK query filter). ``field`` is a LinkML slot name (snake_case, as listed by `hippoSchema`); the equivalent camelCase spelling exposed on the entity type is also accepted. An unrecognized name is an error, never an empty result (issue #149). ``op`` defaults to EQ (equality); IN treats ``value`` as a list and matches when the field is a member of it (issue #102). Comparison and null-test operators (ADR-0006): GT/GTE/LT/LTE on numeric and temporal slots, CONTAINS (case-insensitive substring) on string slots, NEQ on comparable slots, IS_NULL (boolean ``value``; true matches entities with no stored value) everywhere. ``value: null`` is rejected — absence is asked with IS_NULL, never with EQ null.

types.name: JSON
types.description: The `JSON` scalar type represents JSON values as specified by [ECMA-404](https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-404_2nd_edition_december_2017.pdf).

types.name: FilterOp
types.description: Predicate applied to a filter's field/value (SDK filter op). Which operators a given slot supports depends on its kind/range (ADR-0006): comparisons (GT/GTE/LT/LTE) on numeric and temporal slots, CONTAINS (case-insensitive substring) on string slots, IS_NULL everywhere. An operator outside a slot's set is a coded error, never a silently-wrong result (issue #129).

types.name: AuthorFilter
types.description: Typed filter for Author (ADR-0006). Slot fields and multiple operators within one field AND together; nest boolean structure with and/or/not. To-one reference edges nest the target type's filter under the edge name (M5a — one correlated EXISTS); multivalued reference edges nest some/none quantifiers over the target's filter (M5b — EXISTS/NOT EXISTS over the link table). Relationship predicates are not combinable with asOf. Composes with `filters:` by AND.

types.name: StringFilterOps
types.description: Operators on string-ranged slots. `contains` is case-insensitive substring; `%`/`_` are literals.

types.name: BookEdgeQuantifiers
types.description: some/none quantifiers over a multivalued reference edge targeting Book (ADR-0006 M5b). Both set AND together.

types.name: BookFilter
types.description: Typed filter for Book (ADR-0006). Slot fields and multiple operators within one field AND together; nest boolean structure with and/or/not. To-one reference edges nest the target type's filter under the edge name (M5a — one correlated EXISTS); multivalued reference edges nest some/none quantifiers over the target's filter (M5b — EXISTS/NOT EXISTS over the link table). Relationship predicates are not combinable with asOf. Composes with `filters:` by AND.

types.name: AuthorEdgeQuantifiers
types.description: some/none quantifiers over a multivalued reference edge targeting Author (ADR-0006 M5b). Both set AND together.

types.name: BookFormatFilterOps
types.description: Operators on BookFormat-ranged slots.

types.name: BooleanFilterOps
types.description: Operators on boolean-ranged slots.

types.name: IntFilterOps
types.description: Operators on integer-ranged slots (typed comparisons).

types.name: FilterMode
types.description: How multiple filters compose (SDK filter_mode).

types.name: AuthorOrderField
types.description: Orderable stored columns of Author (ADR-0007). Computed temporal fields (createdAt/updatedAt) are provenance-derived, not columns, and are not orderable.

types.name: OrderDirection
types.description: Sort direction for orderBy (ADR-0007).

types.name: FacetCount
types.description: One facet bucket: a stored value of the requested field and how many matching entities carry it (ADR-0007). Entities with no stored value are not counted — query absence with IS_NULL. Availability-consistent: buckets sum over exactly the entities the list query would return under the same filters.

types.name: FieldRange
types.description: Min/max of a field under a filter, for range facets (ADR-0007). Both null when no matching entity has a stored value. Availability-consistent with the list surface.

types.name: BookPage
types.description: Offset-paginated Book result set (mirrors the SDK's PaginatedResult).

types.name: BookOrderField
types.description: Orderable stored columns of Book (ADR-0007). Computed temporal fields (createdAt/updatedAt) are provenance-derived, not columns, and are not orderable.

types.name: ExternalID
types.description:
DEPRECATED (since 0.6.0, issue #48): use the `ExternalReference` value type on a domain slot (optionally annotated `hippo_external_xref` for reverse lookup) instead. ExternalID remains for backward compatibility only and will be removed from hippo_core in a future major release; the SDK methods (`register_external_id`, `get_by_external_id`, `list_external_ids`, mapping-level `supersede`) and the `/external-ids` REST endpoints emit DeprecationWarning / are marked deprecated in OpenAPI.
A stable cross-system identifier linking a Hippo entity to an ID managed by an external source system (e.g., STARLIMS barcode, HALO sample ID, Donor DB donor number). Lifecycle-tracked: each ExternalID instance is created, superseded, and retired via the normal entity machinery — same write path, same provenance, same query semantics as any other entity class. See sec3 §3.4 and the β-refactor handoff (sec9 PR 1.1) for context.
Note on lifecycle flags: `is_available` (inherited from Entity) is the standard entity-lifecycle flag that reflects soft-delete / supersede / archived state. `is_active` is a narrower flag meaning "this external-system mapping is currently in use". An ExternalID may be `is_available: true` (entity-level: not deleted) but `is_active: false` (mapping-level: superseded by a newer mapping).
`(source_system, value)` must be unique within active records (`is_active = true`). The uniqueness constraint is declared here as a logical `unique_keys` block; the partial-index enforcement against `is_active = true` is wired in the DDL wrapper (PR 1.2).

types.name: ExternalIDPage
types.description: Offset-paginated ExternalID result set (mirrors the SDK's PaginatedResult).

types.name: ExternalIDFilter
types.description: Typed filter for ExternalID (ADR-0006). Slot fields and multiple operators within one field AND together; nest boolean structure with and/or/not. To-one reference edges nest the target type's filter under the edge name (M5a — one correlated EXISTS); multivalued reference edges nest some/none quantifiers over the target's filter (M5b — EXISTS/NOT EXISTS over the link table). Relationship predicates are not combinable with asOf. Composes with `filters:` by AND.

types.name: ExternalIDOrderField
types.description: Orderable stored columns of ExternalID (ADR-0007). Computed temporal fields (createdAt/updatedAt) are provenance-derived, not columns, and are not orderable.

types.name: Review
types.description: A review of a Book. Third entity in the atomic-workflow batch (Author → Book → Review), so the golden path stages a three-node linked set and commits it all-or-nothing.

fields.name: book
fields.description: Resolved Book for `book` (graph traversal; batched per request).

types.name: ReviewPage
types.description: Offset-paginated Review result set (mirrors the SDK's PaginatedResult).

types.name: ReviewFilter
types.description: Typed filter for Review (ADR-0006). Slot fields and multiple operators within one field AND together; nest boolean structure with and/or/not. To-one reference edges nest the target type's filter under the edge name (M5a — one correlated EXISTS); multivalued reference edges nest some/none quantifiers over the target's filter (M5b — EXISTS/NOT EXISTS over the link table). Relationship predicates are not combinable with asOf. Composes with `filters:` by AND.

types.name: ProvenanceEntry
types.description: One provenance log entry for an entity (append-only audit trail; see sec6/sec9 §9.6).

types.name: SupersessionInfo
types.description: Entity-level supersession state (mirrors REST GET /entities/{id}/superseded). `supersededBy` is the direct replacement (null when the entity is current); `chain` follows replacement links forward to the terminal replacement.

types.name: XrefMatch
types.description: Entity resolved from an external reference (system, value) pair via the hippo_external_xref reverse-lookup index (issue #48). Generic envelope shape — the matching entity type is only known at query time, so `data` carries the typed payload as JSON; use `entityType` with the per-type queries for typed traversal.

types.name: RelatedEntity
types.description: An entity that references the queried entity through a relationships-table-backed multivalued slot (ADR-0002) — the reverse of forward multivalued-reference resolution (issue #146). Generic envelope shape — the referencing entity's type is only known at query time, so `data` carries the typed payload as JSON; use `entityType` with the per-type queries for typed traversal.

types.name: SearchHit
types.description: One cross-class search hit (issue #158): a heterogeneous JSON envelope — the matching entity's type is only known at query time, so `data` carries the typed payload as JSON; use `entityType` with the per-type queries for typed traversal. `score` is the FTS rank, normalized to [0, 1] per index (comparable in relative terms across classes).

types.name: Float
types.description: The `Float` scalar type represents signed double-precision fractional values as specified by [IEEE 754](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEEE_floating_point).

types.name: NeighborhoodGraph
types.description: A depth-bounded subgraph around one entity (issue #158): renderable without further queries. `edgeSources` names the edge stores covered by this response; `notices` discloses any bound hit (node budget) or scoped-out coverage (column edges under asOf) — the graph is never silently partial.

types.name: GraphNode
types.description: One node of a neighborhood subgraph (issue #158) — the same heterogeneous JSON envelope as SearchHit/XrefMatch.

types.name: GraphEdge
types.description: One directed edge of a neighborhood subgraph. `type` is the referencing slot / relationship type; `edgeSource` names the store it came from — LINK_TABLE (relationship-backed multivalued references, ADR-0002) or COLUMN (single-valued reference slots).

types.name: MosaicEntityTypeInfo
types.description: One exposed entity type from the deployment's merged LinkML schema (mirrors REST GET /schemas). This is Mosaic's *domain* schema introspection — the LinkML type model the GraphQL surface itself is generated from.

types.name: MosaicSlotInfo
types.description: One slot of an entity type, as classified by the shared LinkML type model (mosaic.core.schema_typing).

types.name: MosaicReferenceInfo
types.description: One relationship of an entity type (mirrors REST GET /schemas/{type}/references).

types.description: Summary of a bulk availability change (mirrors REST POST /entities/{type}/bulk-availability): per-record error isolation — failures never roll back sibling successes.

types.name: BulkAvailabilityFailure
types.description: One per-entity failure from a bulk availability change.

types.description: Result of a supersede operation.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

fields.name: types
fields.description: A list of all types supported by this server.

fields.name: queryType
fields.description: The type that query operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: mutationType
fields.description: If this server supports mutation, the type that mutation operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: subscriptionType
fields.description: If this server support subscription, the type that subscription operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: directives
fields.description: A list of all directives supported by this server.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name, description and optional `specifiedByURL`, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given `__Type` is.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __InputValue
types.description: Arguments provided to Fields or Directives and the input fields of an InputObject are represented as Input Values which describe their type and optionally a default value.

fields.name: defaultValue
fields.description: A GraphQL-formatted string representing the default value for this input value.

types.name: __EnumValue
types.description: One possible value for a given Enum. Enum values are unique values, not a placeholder for a string or numeric value. However an Enum value is returned in a JSON response as a string.

types.name: __Directive
types.description:
A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.

types.name: __DirectiveLocation
types.description: A Directive can be adjacent to many parts of the GraphQL language, a __DirectiveLocation describes one such possible adjacencies.
